items.problem: Bootstrap omitted source, XAML, styles, and assets linked from outside the -Source directory.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 108-124 copied 4 files; PowerGrid.csproj lines 94-169 declares 16 external Include/Link items; turns 4-18 manually reconstructed the omissions.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for Link, shared, project items, Compile Include, and Page Include; discovery was only Get-ChildItem -Recurse under -Source.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap treated the physical project directory as the complete source graph instead of treating evaluated project items and Link metadata as authoritative.
items.proposed_fix: Parse old-style csproj project items, expand common properties, and copy external items to their logical Link paths before namespace rewrite and triage.
items.generalizes: Old-style UWP samples and enterprise projects commonly share App/MainPage, resources, assets, or scenario XAML through linked project items.

items.problem: Test-AppLaunch could not find output from a valid default dotnet build.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3193-3200 returned unavailable for bin\x64\Debug; the preceding successful build emitted bin\Debug\net10.0...\win-x64 and validator later launched successfully.
items.skill_search: Searched Test-AppLaunch.ps1 for bin, Platform, Debug, and launchFolder; only bin\<arch>\Debug candidates were searched.
items.wrong_text_if_any: The build-output layout is discovered under bin/<arch>/Debug/<tfm>/win-<rid>.
items.root_cause: Output discovery assumed callers always supplied an explicit Platform property.
items.proposed_fix: Recursively select the newest complete exe plus AppxManifest layout under bin.
items.generalizes: Native dotnet builds may place WinUI output under either bin\Debug or bin\<Platform>\Debug depending on command and project properties.

items.problem: WMC9999 guidance asserted a unique missing-resource root cause.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3017-3031 and 3063-3075 show specific CS/WMC errors preceding WMC9999; fixing those earlier errors made the build pass.
items.skill_search: Searched MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for WMC9999; the Resources note said to treat it as a dangling resource key.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Treat WMC9999 on a XAML build as a dangling resource key.
items.root_cause: WMC9999 is a secondary compiler crash shared by multiple upstream XAML/code failures.
items.proposed_fix: Require resolving preceding CS#### and specific WMC#### diagnostics first; retain missing resources only as a fallback hypothesis.
items.generalizes: Opaque XAML compiler internal errors routinely accompany more specific primary diagnostics in WinUI migrations.

items.problem: Bootstrap and validator disagreed on the no-deferred-items marker.
items.evidence: session-log.txt line 3210 warned that MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md had content despite no defer rows; bootstrap emitted a '(none)' table row while validator expected 'No items deferred'.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 for no-defer handling; their sentinel formats differed.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Initialize wrote '| (none) | - |' while Validate looked for 'No items deferred'.
items.root_cause: Producer and consumer used inconsistent empty-state contracts.
items.proposed_fix: Have bootstrap emit the exact no-items sentence recognized by the validator.
items.generalizes: Every migration with zero deferred rows otherwise produces the same false warning.
